metadata.title: Simply connected quotients of fake quadrics
metadata.abstract: Fake quadrics are minimal complex surfaces of general type with $b_1=0$ and $e=4$. The paper gives a short introduction to their arithmetic construction, aimed at low-dimensional topologists, and studies their holomorphic and antiholomorphic quotients and their fundamental groups. The running example in the paper comes from a quaternion algebra over a totally real cubic field. The lattice is generated by three explicit pairs of matrices. A holomorphic involution gives (after resolving the singularities) a simply connected minimal complex surface of general type with $p_g=0$ and $K^2=4$, a smooth $4$-manifold homeomorphic but non-diffeomorphic to $CP^2$ blown up $5$ times. An antiholomorphic involution gives a smooth four-manifold homeomorphic to $S^4$, with a knotted torus as branch locus.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 假二次曲面的单连通商
analysis.workSummary: 介绍假二次曲面的算术构造，并研究全纯及反全纯商的基本群。作者以全实三次域上的四元数代数给显式格和对合。
techniques: 四流形基本群与分支曲面
analysis.breakthrough: 全纯对合商解消后得到pg=0、K²=4的单连通极小一般型曲面，其光滑流形同胚但不微分同胚于CP²#5反向CP²。反全纯商同胚于S⁴，分支集为打结环面。
analysis.limitations: 反全纯商只声明同胚S⁴，未声明标准光滑S⁴。结论依赖文中显式算术例与对合。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第4页明确ChatGPT和Claude编写附档程序，计算格基本域体积上界、检查格关系及其他四元数代数的初步计算，并用于排版和语言编辑。第11页两处A. I.是参考文献作者Stipsicz的名字缩写。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09603v1 · PDF第4页 Statement on the use of AI

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第4页明确ChatGPT和Claude编写附档程序，计算格基本域体积上界、检查格关系及其他四元数代数的初步计算，并用于排版和语言编辑。第11页两处A. I.是参考文献作者Stipsicz的名字缩写。
